subject: Introduction to Mechanical Engineering
title: Engineering — MCQ Practice
note: Original ACADRIX practice MCQs based on the existing Unit I 1-mark bank. Not official university questions or verified PYQs.

questions.q: Which statement best describes Mechanical Engineering?
options: The study of only electrical circuits
The engineering discipline concerned with design, analysis, manufacture, operation and maintenance of machines and energy systems
The study of only chemical reactions
The study of only civil structures
questions.answer: The engineering discipline concerned with design, analysis, manufacture, operation and maintenance of machines and energy systems
questions.explanation: Mechanical Engineering covers machines, devices and energy systems through design, analysis, manufacturing, operation and maintenance.

questions.q: Which development strongly accelerated Mechanical Engineering during the Industrial Revolution?
questions.explanation: Steam power, mechanised production and machine-tool development were major drivers of mechanical engineering during the Industrial Revolution.

questions.q: Force is a:
questions.explanation: Force has both magnitude and direction, so it is a vector quantity.

questions.q: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.explanation: The SI derived unit of force is the newton (N).

questions.q: Which equation represents Newton's second law?
questions.explanation: Newton's second law relates the resultant force to mass and acceleration: ΣF = ma.

questions.q: Velocity is the rate of change of:
questions.explanation: Velocity is defined as the rate of change of displacement with time.

questions.q: Which is the SI unit of acceleration?
questions.explanation: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity and has SI unit metre per second squared.

questions.q: For a constant force F acting through displacement s at angle θ, work is:
questions.explanation: Only the component of force along the displacement does work, giving W = Fs cosθ.

questions.q: Work is zero for a constant force when the force is:
options: In the same direction as displacement
questions.explanation: For θ = 90°, cosθ = 0, so W = Fs cosθ = 0.

questions.q: Which expression represents kinetic energy?
questions.explanation: Kinetic energy associated with translational motion is KE = ½mv².

questions.q: Which expression represents gravitational potential energy near Earth's surface?
questions.explanation: Near Earth's surface, gravitational potential energy relative to a reference level is PE = mgh.

questions.q: Power is best defined as the:
options: Rate at which work is done or energy is transferred
questions.answer: Rate at which work is done or energy is transferred
questions.explanation: Power measures how quickly work is performed or energy is transferred.

questions.q: One watt is equal to:
questions.explanation: The watt is the SI unit of power: 1 W = 1 J/s.

questions.q: Which are the dimensions of force?
questions.explanation: From F = ma, force has dimensions M(LT⁻²) = MLT⁻².

questions.q: Which are the dimensions of work or energy?
questions.explanation: Work = force × distance, giving (MLT⁻²)L = ML²T⁻².

questions.q: Which are the dimensions of power?
questions.explanation: Power is work per time, so ML²T⁻² divided by T gives ML²T⁻³.

questions.q: An equation is dimensionally homogeneous when:
options: Only the first term has units
All terms have the same dimensions
questions.answer: All terms have the same dimensions
questions.explanation: Dimensional homogeneity requires compatible dimensions for all terms that are added or equated.

questions.q: SI stands for:
questions.explanation: SI is the International System of Units used as the modern coherent system of measurement.

questions.q: Which is the SI base unit of mass?
questions.explanation: The kilogram (kg) is the SI base unit of mass.

questions.q: Which statement about engineering ethics is correct?
options: Public safety can always be ignored
Engineers should protect public safety and welfare
Personal interest must always override safety
Engineers need not work within their competence
questions.answer: Engineers should protect public safety and welfare
questions.explanation: Responsible engineering practice places public safety and welfare among core professional responsibilities.

questions.q: A conflict of interest occurs when:
options: Personal or external interests could improperly influence professional judgement
questions.answer: Personal or external interests could improperly influence professional judgement
questions.explanation: A conflict of interest can compromise or appear to compromise objective professional judgement.

questions.q: Which technology is an example of a modern transformation in Mechanical Engineering?
questions.explanation: CAD/CAE and technologies such as CNC, robotics and additive manufacturing have transformed mechanical engineering practice.
